tool_args.rationale: The coupled transient ODE failed fresh confirmation by a large margin, while no chaotic-sign signature is present. The nine available rows and branch-discriminating observation support testing the archived siphon law; fit its base amplitude, gradient coupling, and one of the explicitly archived open branch forms, selecting the lowest training residual and relying on fresh confirmation to assess it.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fitted archived RK4 model was decisively refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 1.1623 versus 0.045 tolerance).

Current data contain repeated horizon H=0.6; however the archived inland-hub and hydraulic-basin law uses the listed current-input/gradient/branch features, making the cheaper open-branch probe plus direct fit the relevant next step.
Additional trajectory measurements are aimed at identifying the already-refuted ODE, not the parsimonious source-hub siphon family.
Auxiliary nuisance data are not relevant to distinguishing the archived stationary mechanisms.
The archived note explicitly says this family fails when s_grad varies; use the gradient-modulated siphon law instead.
The evidence reports no high-frequency sign oscillation; the failed ODE is not sufficient to rule out the other archived stationary mechanism families.
